en.name: Bcrypt
en.short: Hash a password with bcrypt and check a password against a hash.
en.title: Bcrypt hash generator and checker online
en.description: Generate the bcrypt hash of a password with the cost you choose and verify whether a password matches a bcrypt hash ($2a$, $2b$, $2y$). Everything runs in your browser: passwords are never sent.
en.lead: Create a bcrypt hash on the left; verify a password against a hash on the right.
en.tooLong: bcrypt only uses the first 72 bytes of the password.
en.costHint: Each +1 doubles the time. 10–12 is a common choice for servers today.

errors.cost: The cost must be between 4 and 15.
errors.length: The password is longer than 72 bytes.
errors.hash: This is not a valid bcrypt hash.
